qualification.education_qualification: Advocate with 03 years standing at Bar (Legal matters), Bachelor's Degree in Food Technology (60% marks), B.A/B.Sc./M.A/M.Sc. (Psychology) with Diploma/Counselling experience, MBBS with Master's/Diploma in Psychiatric Medicine
qualification.details: Visiting Consultant (Legal Advisor): Advocate with standing of at least 03 years at the Bar with expertise in dealing with service matters at the Hon'ble High Court of Telangana/Central Administrative Tribunal Telangana Circle OR Officers retired from Central/State Government bodies not below the rank of Under Secretary to Government of India or equivalent, having at least 03 years experience in handling legal matters. Food Safety Officer (On Contract): Bachelor's Degree in Food Technology with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/UGC point scale OR any other equivalent/recognized qualification notified by the Central Government or FSSAI. Desirable: Master's Degree in Food Safety/Food Science or related disciplines or Diploma/Certificate in Food Safety/Quality Management. Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience in food safety, quality control or related roles. Student Counsellor (On Contract): B.A/B.Sc. (Psychology) with certificate of Diploma in Counselling with minimum of Three-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes OR M.A/M.Sc. (Psychology) with minimum of Two-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes OR MBBS with Master's/Diploma in Psychiatric Medicine, with minimum of One-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Warangal to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Visiting Consultant (Legal Advisor): Advocate with standing of at least 03 years at the Bar with expertise in dealing with service matters at the Hon'ble High Court of Telangana/Central Administrative Tribunal Telangana Circle OR Officers retired from Central/State Government bodies not below the rank of Under Secretary to Government of India or equivalent, having at least 03 years experience in handling legal matters. Food Safety Officer (On Contract): Bachelor's Degree in Food Technology with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/UGC point scale OR any other equivalent/recognized qualification notified by the Central Government or FSSAI. Desirable: Master's Degree in Food Safety/Food Science or related disciplines or Diploma/Certificate in Food Safety/Quality Management. Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience in food safety, quality control or related roles. Student Counsellor (On Contract): B.A/B.Sc. (Psychology) with certificate of Diploma in Counselling with minimum of Three-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes OR M.A/M.Sc. (Psychology) with minimum of Two-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes OR MBBS with Master's/Diploma in Psychiatric Medicine, with minimum of One-Year Experience in providing counselling to students at Educational Institutes.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Warangal to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NIT Warangal recruitment is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Visiting Consultant (Legal Advisor), Food Safety Officer, and Student Counsellor in NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website of NIT Warangal to fill out and submit their application forms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for these positions ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Food Safety Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Food Safety Officer post, a Bachelor's Degree in Food Technology with at least 60% marks is required. A Master's degree or diploma in Food Safety is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500, while SC/ST and Women candidates need to pay Rs. 300.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NIT Warangal recruitment will involve an Interview. A test may also be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Telangana apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies expertise in dealing with matters at the High Court of Telangana for the Legal Advisor role. For other posts, general eligibility criteria apply, but it's best to check the official notification for any state-specific requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is on a contract basis.
